title: DNA Stretched Out
script: Your DNA is incredibly long If you uncoiled all of it, the string would stretch about 60 billion miles This is enough to travel from Earth to Pluto and back about 12 times Each microscopic cell packs about 2 metres of DNA folded into a space you could never see with the naked eye, multiplied across tens of trillions of cells The diameter of a DNA double helix is only 2 nanometers, meaning if a DNA strand were as thick as a rope, the 2-meter length in a single cell would be equivalent to a rope stretching 20 kilometers If you unravelled the DNA from every cell in your body and laid it in one line, it would stretch to the Sun and back dozens of times over The same physics that packs this much DNA into every cell is what allows it to fit inside you

scenes.voiceover: If you uncoiled all of it, the string would stretch about 60 billion miles
This is enough to travel from Earth to Pluto and back about 12 times
Each microscopic cell packs about 2 metres of DNA folded into a space you could never see with the naked eye, multiplied across tens of trillions of cells
The diameter of a DNA double helix is only 2 nanometers, meaning if a DNA strand were as thick as a rope, the 2-meter length in a single cell would be equivalent to a rope stretching 20 kilometers
If you unravelled the DNA from every cell in your body and laid it in one line, it would stretch to the Sun and back dozens of times over
The same physics that packs this much DNA into every cell is what allows it to fit inside you

captions: How long is your DNA? Did you know it's long enough to reach the Sun and back?
DNA length is a mind-blowing fact
The scale of DNA is hard to wrap your head around
